title: About the UK House Price Index
key_point: UK HPI is hedonic mix-adjusted (floor area, rooms, type, new/existing, ACORN); first estimate ~40% of sales; 12-month revisions; 2025 kNN imputation.

title: Down valuation (MSE forum thread)
key_point: £50k down-valuation on £330k; adviser: appeal without clear comparables usually futile; lenders differ widely; keep offer while trying another lender.

title: What to do when there's a down valuation
key_point: 25 replies: 25% NatWest down-valuation, drive-by valuers miss interior upgrades, subsidence history worry, typical outcome renegotiation/meet in middle.

title: Zoopla - how accurate is their housing estimate?
key_point: Estimates = last sale plus area factor; fine for common terraces, poor for unique homes, extensions, Right-to-Buy discounted sales.

title: How accurate are Zoopla property price estimates?
key_point: 28 replies mostly negative; £100-200k errors; ignores renovations and condition; better with recent sales and homogeneous streets.

title: Take a Look Around: Using Street View and Satellite Images to Estimate House Prices (Law, Paige, Russell)
key_point: London 130,557 sales: image features lift R2 72.5%->84.7%; unseen Southwark 62.7%->76.5%; aerial beats street-level.

title: Uncertainty quantification in automated valuation models with spatially weighted conformal prediction (Hjort et al.)
key_point: Oslo 26,362 sales: naive AVM intervals unevenly calibrated across districts; CQR and spatially weighted calibration give more even coverage.

title: Appraising Home Purchase Appraisals (Calem, Lambie-Hanson, Nakamura, Kenney)
key_point: US: ~30% of appraisals equal contract price, <10% below; bunching at LTV notches; AVMs more informative of default risk.

title: Defining Street-based Local Area and measuring its effect on house price using a hedonic price approach: London
key_point: Multi-level hedonic, 5,344 London sales 2011: local-area effect >30% of price variance; street-network areas beat administrative units.

title: Does energy efficiency matter to home-buyers? EPC ratings and transaction prices in England (Fuerst et al.)
key_point: 333,095 repeat sales: A/B +5%, C +1.8%, G -7% vs D; premiums small or insignificant in London/South East.

title: A divide-and-conquer approach for spatio-temporal analysis of large house price data from Greater London
key_point: 0.6m+ London sales across 983 MSOAs over 8 years modelled with Gaussian processes; abstract only read.

title: Fifty not out: RICS Red Book celebrates half a century
key_point: Red Book since 1976; ~£10tn UK property valued under it; biennial updates; RICS reviewing AI, big data, sustainability.

title: RICS releases updated home valuation guidance for flats in buildings with cladding
key_point: From 1 Nov 2026 EWS1 only with defined reason, tiered by storeys; PAS 9980 fire risk appraisal summary may substitute.

title: Council tax raid raises urgent property valuation questions
key_point: £2m+ surcharge from 2028 (£2.5k-£7.5k bands); VOA to value; no register exists; owners near threshold may seek RICS valuations.

title: BLOG: Mansion Tax threshold drop would treble valuation headache (Tom Bill, Knight Frank)
key_point: Grey zone 73,600 homes at £2m, 222,800 at £1.5m; concentrated London/SE; expect price bunching below thresholds.

title: LSL announces first major automated valuation contract
key_point: AVMs about 25% of UK residential valuations and growing; e.surv iQ blends automated, remote and physical valuations.

title: Agents are anti-AI when it comes to property valuations - agent poll
key_point: Alto poll of 250 agents: 87% say AI valuations miss true value; miss extensions, lofts, condition; undervalue rural and North.

title: Estate agents overvaluing properties claim mortgage brokers
key_point: 71% of brokers doubt agent appraisals survive lender scrutiny; ~20% of JLM cases down-valued; appeals offer little hope.

title: We need insight into the emerging trend of confusing down valuations - Murphy
key_point: ~20% of cases down-valued since Feb 2025 despite rising indices; blames Jan 2025 Red Book modelling and ESG guidance.

title: Down valuations are rising in the mortgage market
key_point: Same home £450k vs £520k a week apart; lenders 16.8% apart; appeals ineffective; London resi fewer down-valuations, BTL more.

title: News Analysis: Down-valuation strife is back
key_point: e.surv 25.2% down-valued Q1 2022; SDL 19.2% by avg 1.54%; Mojo 10% purchase, 18% remortgage; 'over-estimates' framing.

title: Providence Equity Partners set to buy Hometrack
key_point: Hometrack serves 16 of top 20 UK lenders and all 14 leading Dutch lenders; acquisition announced Aug 2026.

title: Castle Trust Bank introduces AVMs for BTL applications
key_point: AVM eligibility: max 65% LTV, max £750k value, standard houses and single flats only.

title: Landbay launches Premier Remortgage AVM products, cuts Premier rates
key_point: BTL remortgage AVM products to 75% LTV for landlords with up to 15 mortgaged properties; speed is the rationale.

title: What are down valuations and why are they increasing?
key_point: Rising especially on higher-value London/SE homes; usually 2-5% below price; new-build flats, unique and rural homes scrutinised.

title: Why are down valuations increasing in the UK housing market?
key_point: Surveyors use completed sales not asking prices; reports of 10-30% gaps; appeals need better recent comparables or factual errors.

title: RICS Home Survey Standard - home surveys
key_point: Three survey levels; valuation optional only with Level 2; new report formats mandatory from 1 Sep 2021.

title: Hometrack Automated Valuation Model
key_point: Vendor claims: 18 of top 20 lenders, 80% within 10% of surveyor, 1,600 origination AVMs/day, powers Zoopla estimates.

title: Automated valuation model UK (blog)
key_point: Marketing explainer; no published usage share, LTV caps or accuracy figures.

title: Just how accurate are automated valuations models?
key_point: Cites RICS research: AVMs within ±5% in >80% of standard urban cases; accuracy degrades for heterogeneous local stock.

title: Chimnie vs Hometrack
key_point: Vendor: 35m+ properties, 300+ data points, from £0.05/property; no accuracy metrics published.

title: AVM: what are automated valuation models?
key_point: Generic explainer: ML and geospatial inputs (location, size, characteristics, condition, demand); no FSD or hit-rate detail.

title: Automated Valuation Model UK
key_point: Uses Land Registry, EPC, portal and rental data; gives a confidence score and range; no quantified accuracy published.

title: Automated valuation models after the 2025 rule: accuracy, bias and controls
key_point: US AVM QC rule from 1 Oct 2025 with five factors; Zillow median error ~1.8% on-market vs ~7% off-market.

title: Down valuations rise as surveyors become judge, jury and executioner - warning
key_point: Blocked (403); headline only: down-valuations reported rising in 2025.

title: PwC AVM Benchmarking Survey 2026
key_point: Blocked (403); lender AVM benchmarking survey exists but content not read.

title: Metrics for evaluating the performance of machine learning based automated valuation models (Steurer, Hill, Pfeifer)
key_point: Blocked (403); known paper on AVM accuracy metrics, not read.
